newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Foreign investment in Seoul stocks falls in July.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment in Seoul stocks falls in July.

text.p: Net foreign investment in the South Korean stock market in July fell to 231.9 billion won from 633.2 billion in June, the Securities Supervisory Board said on Tuesday.
Foreign stock buying fell to 936.6 billion in July against 1.41 trillion in June, a board statement said.
The board said foreign investors sold stocks worth 704.7 billion in July, down from 774.2 billion in June.
A board official said the net stock investment had been slipping since May, when South Korea raised the foreign stock ownership limit to 23 percent of an individual stock from 20 percent.
